name: market_event_plan_stamp_lq369_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: MARKET_EVENT_PLAN_STAMP — LQ-20261107-369: WP6 outcomes scores the tranche stamps in
market_event_candidates.plan; WP3 computed the plan at read time and never wrote it, so outcomes could
only ever use the first_seen basis. This gate pins the deterministic, idempotent persist (one snapshot per
state change, account LABEL only, guarded UPDATE) and that outcomes reads it as the plan_stamp basis.
Synthetic fixtures; no broker, order or write path.
